name: RebotHub
subtitle: Fix it, value it, or give it a second home. RebotHub is the second-life guide for the robots people actually own, and the first stop for the used humanoids that are coming.
ownerBlurb: Dan builds things, films them, and runs the bots behind this site. He is not a licensed electrician or a manufacturer technician. Every page says who checked it and when.
marketDomainNote: RebotMarket.com will redirect here during year one.
disclosure: RebotHub earns a commission if you buy through some links on this page, at no extra cost to you. Prices are never shown here because they change; the button opens the current listing. Our verdicts are written before any link is chosen.
safetyGeneral: Unplug the robot and remove it from its dock before opening anything. Never puncture, bend, heat, or charge a swollen or damaged lithium battery. If a pack is swollen, stop and take it to a battery recycling point. Use the manufacturer's part number or a pack the manufacturer lists as compatible.
